additional_context: The current authoritative narrative source, source/foundation-module.html, is included in source/hierarchy.xml as the Foundation module page. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant discussion or minutes that conflict with this conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current source already implements the requested correction in the build-scope foundation module page.
